note: Private common IPA 725 = the delivered 724 with every fix ready on 11 November 2026 (maintainer request). RPCS3 Core 928 (= 923 + 924 to 928): an accurate PUTLLC defers to a starving PPU before it locks its line (Black Ops II freeze of IPA 724); GPU memory packing (Black Ops II graphics memory); texture lookup memo served for Black Ops II; asynchronous MoltenVK submits definitive for every title that does not use asynchronous texture streaming, without boot record; the GPU gate closes when the application is deactivated and reopens when it is active again. Host: the RPCS3 database no longer turns asynchronous texture streaming on under iOS (God of War III corruption of IPA 724). MeloNX Core 731 (= 723 + 725 + 727 + 729 + 731) with the five-part MoltenVK patch (99605a2b): recorded pipeline states replayed at load, pause checkpoint growth, pipeline cache compacted once at load, cached shader libraries kept under the bindings a lookup reads, cold buffer trim; bridge journal fields. Skins PR 171 and 173 with the fourth Pocket revision review. Imports (maintainer requests of 11 November): every import says why a file is refused; a library folder shows which console folder feeds which playlist before it is added, and a folder iOS does not give back keeps its games; 'already in the library' compares the bytes; nothing is overwritten. Launch prerequisites: LocalDevVPN, pairing file, development signature, iOS version, PS2 BIOS and conditional retro BIOS each say what is missing and what to do. The S2Arm diagnostic hook of the MeloNX bridge is inert in this build (no Info.plist key). Base: the delivered and verified 724. Nothing of this build was run on an iPhone; no FPS, memory or stability claim.
